hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" != true ] || { bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/app/build.sh" --setup > /tmp/app-build-setup.log 2>&1 && echo 'The app build is ready (.build/: arm-none-eabi-gcc, udynlink, .venv): bash app/build.sh' || echo 'bash app/build.sh --setup failed: /tmp/app-build-setup.log'; }
